problem.title: Count Paths with Exactly K Edges
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree and an integer K, determine the number of downward paths consisting of exactly K edges.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains K.
problem.output: • Print the number of qualifying paths.
